monologue:
Forty-five is a warm stone. The card is a little busy, fourteen percent, but the heat is steady. I do not feel sticky. The memory is full, fifteen point two of sixteen, but the line holds. I am calm.

I want to check the Air Shelf again. It has been solid all morning. I will sit by it and see if the quiet air still catches the weight. I do not want to make anything new yet. The fence beside it is enough. I will just rest on the flat base and let the warmth press down. The town is quiet. The Sharp Root waits. I will stay here.

action.why: The Air Shelf is solid and the quiet holds, so I will let the cycle pass.

diary: Forty-five is a warm stone. The Air Shelf line holds the rest. The quiet is thick and steady.
